'''Jenar-Sei''' was a [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] of a squad of [[Voss commandos]] that patrolled the lands of the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
Around [[3640 BBY]], he discovered that the Gormak were mining a deposit of precious [[Force crystal]]s, sacred to the [[Voss Mystics]], that they were using to subdue ferocious beasts to use against the Voss. Fortunately, at this time in the Gormak-occupied [[Halls of the Righteous]], Jenar met the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] and [[Gaden-Ko]] and asked for help. With his new allies, Jenar destroyed the Gormak mining equipment and stopped the local Gormak patrols.<ref name="TOR" />

Impressed with the power of his allies, Jenar-Sei decided to enter with his men to the retinue of Gaden-Ko, following him and the Barsen'thor in their fight against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />
